title: A `session.hello` whose `display_name` is over 32 UTF-16 code units is `bad_params`
notes: The bound on `display_name` is 32 UTF-16 code units, not 32 bytes and not 32 code points. The refused name is 31 ASCII characters plus one astral character: 32 code points but 33 UTF-16 code units, one unit over, which a code-point bound would admit. The schema's `maxLength` counts Unicode code points and so cannot express the protocol's unit; `refused` is the vector's own signal that the frame is deliberately outside the protocol. The second connection shows the boundary from the other side: 30 ASCII characters plus the same astral character is exactly 32 code units and seats normally.
